title: Family site data, schema version 1
description: The three data files of a family site: data/people.json, data/sources.json and, for a site with a map, data/places.json. Each file is checked against its definition here ($defs.peopleFile, $defs.sourcesFile, $defs.placesFile). See docs/data-format.md for the rules in words.

personId.description: The id of a person in people.json.

confidence.description: How sure the site is of this claim. confirmed: a record says it. probable: the records point to it but a certificate would make it firmer. family tradition: the family says it and no record has been found. unverified: not yet checked.

date.description: The date as far as it is known: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; empty or null when not known. Use display for how the site words it.

display.description: How the site writes the date, e.g. "about 1866" or "spring 1901 (registered)".

dateQualifier.description: Optional: how exact the date is.

placeId.description: Id of a place in places.json (sites with a map).

confidence.description: How sure the site is of this claim. confirmed: a record says it. probable: the records point to it but a certificate would make it firmer. family tradition: the family says it and no record has been found. unverified: not yet checked.

sourceIds.description: Ids of entries in sources.json that support this claim.

alternates.description: Other dates the records give for the same event.

event.description: A life event: birth, death or burial.

id.description: A stable id: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Never reuse or rename one; pages link to it.

displayName.description: The name shown on the card and in headings.

surname.description: Surname at birth, or the surname the site uses.

disambiguator.description: A short line that tells this person apart: "Reg, Pat's father" or "nee Bennett, Pat's mother". Shown under the name.

confidence.description: How sure the site is of this claim. confirmed: a record says it. probable: the records point to it but a certificate would make it firmer. family tradition: the family says it and no record has been found. unverified: not yet checked.

sourceIds.description: Ids of entries in sources.json that support this claim.

nameVariants.description: Other spellings and names the records use.

nameUncertain.description: The name itself is not certain.

sex.description: M, F or U (unknown). Used for relationship words and couple order.

isLiving.description: The person is, or may be, alive. The engine shows "Living" and uses the present tense; it shows whatever else this record holds.

placeholder.description: A stand-in for someone not yet identified ("Woman and girl, Camden Town").

kin.description: A relative whose exact link is not known; drawn in the kin box.

isDirectLine.description: On the root person's direct line of ancestry.

generation.description: Row on the tree, 0 for the oldest generation shown.

order.description: Layout hint: order among brothers and sisters, oldest first.

layoutJoin.description: Layout hint: id of the partner whose family this person is drawn in, when both have parents on the tree.

uncertainBeside.description: Layout hint: id of the person this one is drawn beside, joined by a dashed line, with no proven link.

uncertainLink.description: The link to the parents is not proven; the card is drawn dashed.

region.description: A named group on the tree ("orkney"), used by tree.hiddenRegions and the framed regions in tree.regions.

confidence.description: How sure the site is of this claim. confirmed: a record says it. probable: the records point to it but a certificate would make it firmer. family tradition: the family says it and no record has been found. unverified: not yet checked.

parentLinkConfidence.description: How sure the link to the parents is; probable and unverified links are drawn dashed.

relation.description: partner for a couple who did not marry.

marriageDate.description: The date as far as it is known: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; empty or null when not known. Use display for how the site words it.

photo.description: Picture for the card. With tree.cardPhotos "best", a card with no photo uses the best picture in media.

portrait.description: A larger portrait for the profile.

cardPlace.description: The short place line on the card.

summary.description: One or two sentences: who this person was.

story.description: Markdown. Cite sources as [^source-id]; the id must be in sources.json.

record.description: The record that would answer it.

layout.description: Reserved for layout hints in later versions.

dateStart.description: The date as far as it is known: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; empty or null when not known. Use display for how the site words it.

factRef.description: Which people.json fact this event mirrors ("person-id.birth"); empty when places.json is the only source.

kind.description: home, church, town, port, workplace, cemetery, registration district ...

precision.description: How exact the point is: address, building, street, parish, town, registration district, county, country.

coordinateSourceIds.description: Ids of entries in sources.json that support this claim.

inHomeRegion.description: Inside the site's home region (map.home). Older data says inEngland.

inEngland.description: Older name for inHomeRegion; read when inHomeRegion is absent.

country.description: Optional: the country, for questions such as "who went to Italy?".

blurbSourceIds.description: Ids of entries in sources.json that support this claim.

type.description: census, parish register, newspaper, photograph, family testimony, web ...

source.description: A record the site relies on.

meta.description: About the data, not how it is shown. Settings for how the tree looks live in site.config.json.
